parent_component: none: the parent declares rungs 60/132/240/441/927 and no rung between 441 and 927; this document adds rung J as a descriptive midpoint and does not extend a registered component
purpose_zh: 在已注册的 441 与 927 交易日之间取一个中点档位（600 交易日，2021-05-13..2023-10-31），只用于描述性判断数据量曲线在何处拐弯：此前只有端点，无法判断中间是否存在峰或平台。
purpose: one descriptive interior point of the registered data axis; the endpoints 441 and 927 remain the decision rungs and the only ones that can move a verdict
declared_before_any_score_note: no run of these three (seed, rung) combinations has an out-of-sample score yet; the seeds are the registered anchor seeds reused at a new rung, and their scores at other rungs are irrelevant here because this document declares no threshold and no comparison against a fixed bar
why: the registered axis jumps 441 -> 927 (2.1x in samples): a plateau, a rising line and an interior peak are all consistent with the two endpoint scores
a point in between costs one rung of compute and turns the curve's shape from unidentifiable into measured, at matched effective-epoch points and an unchanged evaluation caliber
the rung is watched for shape only: it may not by itself escalate a dose claim, replace the incumbent or be reported as a candidate
point_role: descriptive curve-shape point, not a promotion arm

window_provenance.source: /root/data/cpt_jyc_2026_vwap (label archive, `date` column of all 58 month files)
window_provenance.note: 2021-05-13 is the 328th trading day of the 927-day window, i.e. the first of its last 600

derived.note: the driver re-derives usable samples and steps from the pool it builds; the plan's +/-5% deviation tolerance is the post-run monitoring rule, not an automatic gate

unchanged.recipe: every field of the registered 927-day recipe except the training-window start and the fields derived from it (experiment_id, output_root, data.cache_dir, budget.max_train_samples, hypothesis, factor block of the plan)
unchanged.budget_points: the same two points, 1.32 and 2.64 effective epochs, one continuous trajectory
unchanged.evaluation: the same five-window delivery caliber (104 trading days) used for every rung

reading_rule: read only as a descriptive shape point between the 441-day and 927-day rungs; it declares no threshold, no verdict and no candidate, and the parent decision is taken from its own registered rungs whether or not this point is ever scored

cost.basis: 30.3 steps/s measured on hz-t3 by featnorm-control-seed11 (/root/runs/featnorm-control-seed11/20261028T060829.804730Z_15124166eb98, 86 976 steps in 2 870.59 s at 132 trading days); the extrapolation assumes the same per-step cost at a larger pool and three concurrent single-GPU processes
